title: DUI Realignment and Mid-Term Package Changes on the Named Non-Owner Policy
content:
**Policy.** When a DUI-related FR-44 Operator certificate requirement of the named insured is recorded, an FR-44 Operator Certificate filing of the named insured whose status is requested, filed or rejected, while the Named Non-Owner Policy term carries a package that does not accept a DUI or DWI conviction within 60 months, the term is realigned mid-term to Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50, the highest package that accepts such a conviction and lists both Florida and Virginia among its FR-44 states, provided the named insured's violation points do not exceed that package's new-business maximum of 12; its full-term premium is re-rated under the realignment rule and the change takes effect on the day it is made and never earlier; every other mid-term package change still takes effect on the requested date, never earlier, and is still refused when it would leave an FR-44 Operator certificate backed by a package outside the package's FR-44 filing states.

**Effect of a package change.** The term moves onto the package elected and its full-term premium is set to the re-rated figure for that package. The term's dates, violation points and the certificate it backs stay as they are, and no premium entry is booked by the change itself. The insured sees the new package and full-term premium on the term.

## Invocation: `change_nonowner_package_67dc97ad`
The change puts into effect the named insured's own election of a package. The agent unlocks `change_nonowner_package_67dc97ad` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nonowner_policy_id` | the reference number of the in-force Named Non-Owner Policy term whose package is changed, as returned by the non-owner policy lookup for the caller | identifier |
| `new_variant_name` | the package the term moves to | exactly one of the six values below |
| `rerated_full_term_premium` | the full-term premium of the term on the new package, in US dollars | a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

| `new_variant_name` value | When it is the package elected |
|---|---|
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits" | the term is to carry the residence state's minimum limits without uninsured motorist cover beyond what the state mandates |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM" | the term is to carry the state minimum limits with uninsured motorist cover equal to them |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50" | the term is to carry 50,000/100,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50" | the term is to carry 100,000/200,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50" | the term is to carry 100,000/300,000/50,000 limits |
| "Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100" | the term is to carry 250,000/500,000/100,000 limits |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation naming the term reference number, the previous package, the new package and the new full-term premium in US dollars with 2 decimals. The appearance of the new package in the confirmation means the change took effect.
